summarization:
The smartphone UI screen displays an application named "elfarras App." The main content of the screen consists of a collection of simple, black-and-white line drawings of various car shapes and parts. The drawings are arranged in a grid format with three rows and three columns. Each row contains different car shapes and parts, including:

1. Top row: Three different car body shapes.
2. Middle row: Two car roof shapes and two car chassis with wheels.
3. Bottom row: One car roof shape and two complete car drawings.

At the bottom of the screen, there are navigation controls, including a close button (X) on the left and left/right arrow buttons for navigating through different screens or images.
